pub fn value(input: Option<u32>) -> u32 { input.unwrap_or(0) }
pub fn value(input: Result<u32, ()>) -> Result<u32, ()> { Ok(input?) }

pub enum Choice { A, B }
pub fn value(input: Choice) -> u32 { match input { Choice::A => 1, Choice::B => 2 } }
pub fn value(input: Option<Option<u32>>) -> u32 { input.unwrap().unwrap() }
